title: Delivery policy
summary: Where we deliver, how fast, and what it costs.

sections.heading: Karachi
body: Orders confirmed before 2 pm are delivered the same day across Karachi, including Clifton, DHA, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Gulistan-e-Jauhar, North Nazimabad, PECHS, Bahadurabad and Malir.
Orders confirmed after 2 pm are delivered the next day. You can pick a delivery slot at checkout: 10 am – 2 pm, 2 – 6 pm or 6 – 10 pm.
Delivery in Karachi costs Rs 250. It is free on orders of Rs 10,000 or more.

sections.heading: Other cities
body: We deliver to most cities in Pakistan through our courier partners. Delivery usually takes 2 – 4 working days.

Cakes and fresh flowers are made by local partners in each city, so the design may differ slightly from the picture. Some items are available in Karachi only; the shop shows only what can reach the city you choose.
Delivery outside Karachi costs Rs 450. It is free on orders of Rs 10,000 or more.

sections.heading: On the day
body: Our rider calls the recipient before arriving. If the recipient cannot be reached after two calls, we contact you to arrange a new time. A second delivery attempt may be charged.
Please give a complete address and a phone number the recipient will answer. Surprise deliveries are fine — tell us in the order note and we will not mention who it is from.

title: Refunds and cancellations
summary: What happens if something is wrong, or you change your mind.

sections.heading: Cancelling an order
body: You can cancel free of charge until we start preparing your order. For same-day orders that is usually within an hour of confirmation.
Custom baskets, cakes and fresh flowers cannot be cancelled once they are being prepared.

sections.heading: If something arrives damaged or wrong
body: Send us a photo on WhatsApp within 24 hours of delivery. We will replace the item or refund it, whichever you prefer.
Perishable items (cakes, flowers, mithai) must be reported on the day of delivery.

sections.heading: How refunds are paid
body: Card and bank-transfer payments are refunded to the original account within 7 – 10 working days.
Cash-on-delivery orders are refunded by bank transfer or as store credit, whichever you choose.

title: Privacy policy
summary: What we collect, why, and how to ask us to delete it.

sections.heading: What we collect
body: Your name, phone number and email; the recipient's name, phone number and address; your gift note; and your order history.
Your basket and city choice are kept in your own browser so they are still there when you come back.

sections.heading: Why we use it
body: To make and deliver your order, to contact you or the recipient about it, and, only if you ask, to send occasion reminders and offers.
We never sell your details. We share the recipient's name, phone and address with the rider or courier delivering the gift, and nothing more.

sections.heading: Your choices
body: You can ask us to correct or delete your details at any time by WhatsApp or email. You can unsubscribe from our messages with one reply.

title: Terms of service
summary: The agreement between you and Little Surprises when you order.

sections.heading: Orders and prices
body: All prices are in Pakistani rupees and include packaging. An order is confirmed when we send you a confirmation by WhatsApp, SMS or email.
Prices of some items differ by city; you pay the price shown for the delivery city you chose.

sections.heading: Products and pictures
body: Pictures show how a product usually looks. Flowers, cakes and hampers are made by hand, so colours and arrangement may vary. If an item is unavailable we will offer a substitute of equal or higher value, or a refund.

sections.heading: Payment
body: We accept cash on delivery, bank transfer and card. For orders above Rs 25,000 or outside Karachi we may ask for advance payment.

title: Frequently asked questions
summary: Quick answers about gifting with us.

sections.heading: Can I add a personal note?
body: Yes, every order includes a free handwritten note on our gift tag. Add it in the basket builder or at checkout.

sections.heading: Can I hide the price from the recipient?
body: Yes. We never put prices or receipts inside the gift.

sections.heading: Do you do bulk or corporate orders?
body: Yes, with no minimum. We can add your logo to the tag and deliver to many addresses from one list. Message us on WhatsApp for a quote.

sections.heading: Can I change what's inside a ready-made basket?
body: Yes. Use the basket builder to start from any basket and add or remove treats.
